scope.purpose: Run one authoritative upstream DRAGON5 lattice/depletion smoke case offline.
does_not_include: committed upstream input, procedure, nuclear-data, raw result, compact export, or golden dataset
a parser, export schema, C# solver work, or DONJON5 work

upstream_case.description: Distributed self-shielding on lumped assemblies; three depletion steps with upstream K-EFFECTIVE assertions.

version5_source.staging_rule: The Git blobs are canonical LF. A local Windows checkout may contain only checkout-inserted CRLF conversion; the runner verifies each Git blob ID, changes only CRLF byte pairs back to LF, rejects bare CR, and then verifies the canonical LF hash and size. The staged files are external run inputs, not repository content.

license_audit.case_file_notice: The selected upstream case and procedures contain author/provenance comments but no individual license header.
license_audit.policy: Use only as an external, offline reference input. Do not vendor, redistribute, or publish the source files or derived raw result.

rejected_p1_t01_current_pin.reason: The direct v5.1.0 lumpSS run reaches step 2 with K-EFFECTIVE 1.314567 instead of the upstream asserted 1.314796; its relative discrepancy exceeds the upstream assertS threshold. The runner rejects this object rather than loosening an assertion.

nuclear_data.pin_rationale: This source-era compatibility object supersedes P1-T01's provisional current-library commit for this one smoke case only. It is the official upstream object that reproduces the v5.1.0 source assertions; the current pinned object is explicitly retained as rejected evidence, not silently substituted.
nuclear_data.redistribution_policy: The compressed asset, decompressed file, and all results remain outside Git. Public availability and the upstream open-source description are not treated as redistribution permission.

execution.direct_execution_reason: The runner stages canonical-LF upstream files and the one data asset outside the image. It invokes the program directly because rdragon assumes a data directory absent from the slim image; checkout CRLF conversion is normalized before direct execution, not attributed to the upstream blobs.
execution.raw_result_policy: Raw result byte hashes are not reproducibility observables because CPU timing text varies. The runner records their SHA-256 for provenance but validates the upstream assertions, three FINAL KINF values, per-step final external convergence, completion markers, and diagnostics instead.
